symptom: ako/mxcli#1780, ako/mxcli#1998 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1762): a packaged or sealed add-on module kept as modules/<Name>.mxmodule did not exist for mxcli — `show modules` omitted it (31 vs Studio Pro's 34 on EvoraICX), `describe nanoflow` said not found, and `check --references` refused valid calls into its public nanoflows.
cause: Such a module has no unit in the .mpr (v1 or v2); its model is the package's own project.mpr — an SQLite v1 .mpr, or the single-BSON module tree protected add-ons ship (mendixlabs/mxcli#1754). Every reader listed only the Unit table.
file: modelsdk/mpr/packaged_modules.go (read modules/*.mxmodule once per reader, module unit attached to the project root; merged into listUnitsByType/Where/InContainer, listUnitTypes, ListUnitHeaders, UnitByID, rawUnitBytes; PackagedUnitError refuses writes in insertUnit/updateUnit/WriteUnit/deleteUnit/MoveUnit/UpdateUnitContainer), modelsdk/mpr/module_tree.go (tree splitter moved from cmd/mxcli/marketplace), mdl/executor/validate_packaged_module.go (check --references predicts the refusal)
insight: Merging at the reader's few internal listing dispatchers reached show/describe/catalog/references without touching any of them; the write guard has to sit in the writer, not the executor, because a v2 updateUnit of an ID the Unit table lacks writes an orphan .mxunit and its UPDATE affects 0 rows without an error — the revert proof showed exactly that. No Studio Pro .mxmodule was available, so fixtures are packages built from a module mxcli wrote, in the two measured shapes; ListAllUnitIDs deliberately stays stored-only (repair/diag write paths).
